title: console UX quality (parent): five defect classes from the objectui 1fb1ced36243 browser pass — false success, missing write feedback, dead-end flows, dishonest status, labels and disabled reasons — plus three polish items
body:
Filing-gate category ④ (coordination node) on the maintainer's order in PM session `session_016JB93R2KcQP4GgKaUnseVF`, verbatim:

> 按这 5 类开父单，派给 objectui 车道，以及：820px 宽度下面包屑重叠。
> * 每个新库首屏都弹时区设置。
> * Home 页的应用卡片不是链接，没法在新标签页打开。

**What this card is:** the grouping of every console UX defect the browser pass of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 found (records objectstack-ai/objectstack#23163 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#23166), by root-cause class, so each class is fixed once through a shared mechanism instead of page by page. ⛔ Not dispatchable itself: its members are the units of work, each in its own lane's queue. **Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat(s), plus the objectstack lanes named for the server-side members.

**Order presented to the maintainer** (most harmful first): **1 → 3 → 2 → 4 → 5**, then the polish items. The members' `priority:*` labels stay triage's; this order is the recommendation the maintainer's instruction above adopted the classes from.

## 1 · The UI says it worked when it did not (data at risk)

Shared direction: one mutation-result layer renders the server's actual outcome (done / nothing changed / conflict) instead of each page calling a success toast; every record write carries its concurrency token; the server refuses a write it will never serve rather than answering 200.

| member | status at filing |
|---|---|
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12292 — list inline edit saves without If-Match, silently overwriting a concurrent write | in flight (`pm:dispatched`) |
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12300 — Setup › Apps Delete / Disable report success for writes that changed nothing (server half: an unserved shadow row answered 200) | in flight (`pm:dispatched`) |
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12286 — master-detail grid rewrote untouched siblings' stored position | **closed (completed)** |
| objectstack-ai/objectstack#23149 — view overlay reset answers `reset:true` while list reads keep serving the overlay | objectstack `domain:engine`, queued |

## 3 · Flows that dead-end

Shared direction: a quick-create that cannot collect every required field hands off to the full form; every emailed link is clicked at least once in e2e.

| member | status at filing |
|---|---|
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12291 — calendar quick-create stuck on a required lookup | queued |
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12301 — OAuth consent page fetches a route the server does not serve | queued |
| objectstack-ai/objectstack#23152 — the user-import invitation link lands on INVALID_TOKEN | routed to objectstack `domain:services` with this card |
| objectstack-ai/objectstack#23128 — showcase Recalculate actions answer 500 | objectstack `domain:cli`, in flight |

## 2 · Writes without feedback, or feedback that names nothing

Shared direction: every write gives feedback naming its subject — the default of the class-1 result layer, so forgetting it still yields feedback.

| member | status at filing |
|---|---|
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12303 rows 1–2 — inline Save All and Discard draft are silent | queued (family card) |
| objectstack-ai/objectstack#23157 row 1 — the approvals drawer says only "Approved." | routed to objectstack `domain:services` with this card |

## 4 · Status the user cannot trust

Shared direction: connection state follows real request outcomes; "no access" and "not found" are different screens.

| member | status at filing |
|---|---|
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12285 — a member gets "This app can't be opened" instead of the access-denied screen (P0 checklist item) | queued |
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12295 — the header connection chip never shows a mid-session outage | queued |

## 5 · Labels over machine names, and disabled controls that say why

Shared direction: one shared name display (label first, machine name secondary, user ids resolved to people) and one shared disabled-reason wrapper (the record page's Archive button is the pattern that already passes).

| member | status at filing |
|---|---|
| objectstack-ai/objectui#12303 rows 3–6 — disabled controls with no reason / no keyboard path; the lookup Display-field picker leads with api names | queued (family card) |
| objectstack-ai/objectui#11862 — Access list and Changes panel lead with machine names | `pm:on-hold`: its `Restart-when:` (objectstack `c512c255c5`'s `_drafts` labels in an installable release) is not met — npm `latest` is still 17.7.0 — and ruling `6053526025` forbids a per-surface label read meanwhile, so it stays held; its independent row moved to #12303 row 6 |
| objectstack-ai/objectstack#23157 row 2 — Explain access's Principal resolution prose names the user by raw id | routed to objectstack `domain:services` with this card |
